behaviour: A unit the CI lab ends without a verdict never fails a gate. Lost means every outcome the scheduler stores no verdict for: a lease that ran out past the lost retries, a worker that reported a crash or that it cannot run the unit, and a job that vanished from the queue. A gate whose units all passed except lost ones concludes neutral, a gate with a failed unit concludes failure whatever else it lost, and the required check is neutral when it would pass had each neutral gate passed and failure otherwise. The summary of every check that holds lost units names how many, their keys and that a rerequest of the check grades them again. Enqueueing a unit whose job ended lost, crashed or unable to run starts that job again in one queue step, as a fresh pending job with all its attempts, so a rerequested grade runs the unit again, its pass turns the gate green, and a grade still waiting on the job reads the fresh run and never the loss; a job that ended with a verdict stays as it is. The lab verdict job still publishes failure for a neutral lab check and prints an error naming the check and the rerequest.
seam: scripts.ci_lab.scheduler.Scheduler.tick over fakeredis, the local object store and a recording poster, scripts.ci_lab.queue.Queue.enqueue over fakeredis, scripts.ci_lab.retry.red, and scripts.ci_lab_verdict.lost and main over scripted check run listings
